comment: Event -> possible narrator lines. Lines are picked at random per event. Audio files (assets/voice/) will map by line id later; V1 scaffold shows captions only. Target: 30-50 starter lines per GAME_SPEC.

game.start: Welcome to Jamaica, brethren! Touch di road!
Wah gwaan! Start di engine — di road nah wait!
One love, one road! Norman Manley deh behind yuh — Ocho Rios ahead!
community.enter: Pass through {community} — real roots community dis!
landmark.enter: Deh deh — {landmark}! Tell di people dem!
pothole.burst: Rhatid — tyre done bruck! Di road a kill yuh, sah!
Lawd have mercy — di pothole ketch yuh! Slow dung next time!
tyre.fixed: Good tings — tyre fix! Back pon di road!
Irie! Tyre good now — press on to Ochi!
pothole.nearmiss: Swerve! Yuh dodge di pothole — good driving, sah!
Close one — dat pothole woulda bruck yuh up good!
dog.chase: Dawg! Dawg a run yuh dung, brethren!
Weh di dog deh pon yuh?! Step pon it!
Rhatid — di dawg dem bad out here!
Dem Kingston dog nuh play — accelerate, man!
dog.chase.kingston: Dat Kingston dawg look both ways before him run — smarter than some drivers!
City dawg dem civilised — check traffic first, THEN run yuh down!
goat.hit: Smaddy goat dat! Yuh owe dem, brethren!
Rhatid! Yuh lick dung di goat!
Cho! Di goat neva see yuh coming either!
Lawd — di farmer a go vex wid yuh! Dat was somebody goat!
goat.nearMiss: Yuh barely miss di goat deh — dat was close, sah!
Lawd! Di goat coulda done yuh — drive careful inna di hills!
speed.high: Yuh a fly, brethren! Slow dung before di police ketch yuh!
Easy, sah — dis nuh racetrack! Di road curving up ahead!
Step pon di brake, man — yuh a drive like yuh late fi Ocho Rios!
score.milestone: Yuh a do well, sah! Keep it moving!
Big score! Di road a treat yuh right!
Respect — yuh a real driver! Ochi getting closer!
faiths.pen.arrive: Faith's Pen! Pull over, nuh — di jerk chicken a call yuh name!
Lawd, smell dat! Jerk chicken and roast yam — best stop pon di island!
Faith's Pen since di 1960s — respect di tradition, pull in!
dunns.river.arrive: Yuh reach! Dunn's River Falls — di water a wait pon yuh!
Journey done! Welcome to Ocho Rios, brethren — now go tek di bath!
From Norman Manley all di way to Dunn's River — respect yuhself!
